options.name: catalog_id
options.description: Catalog ID this instance was created from.

options.name: channel
options.description: Channel to pin the operator subscription to.

options.name: cluster_all_namespaces
options.description: designate to install into all namespaces.

options.name: cluster_id
options.description: Cluster ID.

options.name: cluster_namespaces
options.description: List of target namespaces to install into.

options.name: cluster_region
options.description: Cluster region (e.g., us-south).

options.name: crn
options.description: platform CRN for this instance.

options.name: id
options.description: provisioned instance ID (part of the CRN).

options.name: install_plan
options.description:
Type of install plan (also known as approval strategy) for operator subscriptions.
Can be either automatic, which automatically upgrades operators to the latest in a channel,
or manual, which requires approval on the cluster.

options.name: instance_identifier
options.description: Version Instance identifier.

options.name: kind_format
options.description: the format this instance has (helm, operator, ova...).

options.name: label
options.description: the label for this instance.

options.name: last_operation
options.description: the last operation performed and status.

options.name: metadata
options.description: Map of metadata values for this offering instance.

options.name: offering_id
options.description: Offering ID this instance was created from.

options.name: resource_group_id
options.description: Id of the resource group to provision the offering instance into.

options.name: rev
options.description: Cloudant revision.

options.name: schematics_workspace_id
options.description: Id of the schematics workspace, for offering instances provisioned through schematics.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the resource be present or absent.

options.name: url
options.description: url reference to this object.

options.name: version
options.description: The version this instance was installed from (not version id).

options.name: x_auth_refresh_token
options.description: IAM Refresh token.
